title: Search bar with a growing field
summary: flex-grow: 1 on the field fills the row, while the button keeps its size.
explanation: The field has flex-grow: 1, so it takes all the free width after the button is placed. The button has flex-grow at its default of 0, so it never stretches.
flex-shrink: 0 on the button stops it squeezing when the container gets narrow. Without it the button's text can wrap or get clipped before the field gives up any space.
tryThis: Narrow the preview to 280px and remove flex-shrink: 0 from .go.
Set flex-grow: 2 on .field: nothing changes visibly here, because there is only one growing item.
